policy: Only explicitly verified medicine+diluent combinations should be marked compatible. Unknown combinations remain unverified and must not be mixed based on this tool.

rules.label: NOT VERIFIED
rules.message: No verified compatibility entry is loaded for this medicine + diluent pair. Do not mix in the same syringe/bag/line based on this tool. Check the product insert, pharmacy compatibility reference, or institutional protocol.

rules.label: DO NOT MIX
rules.message: This combination is explicitly marked as incompatible in the clinic compatibility database. Use a separate administration method if clinically appropriate.

rules.label: VERIFIED COMPATIBLE
rules.message: Compatibility has been explicitly entered into the clinic database. Verify concentration, route, stability, administration time and current product information before use.
